notes.title: Patch 6 is here! Improved Save System arrives!
notes.content:
The fixes continue! We've listened to your requests, and we've made some important changes, but let's start at the beginning.

[b]The save system [/b]- a lot is changing here. We have split the save slots into Story Mode and Sandbox, taking the organization a step further. But that's not the end of the changes, we're introducing the ability to [b]manually save the game[/b]!

Also, [b]SANDBOX is now available right away[/b]! You no longer have to play through the entire story mode to unlock the additional sandbox mode.

And then the icing on the cake, more [b]new keybinding features[/b]. Now you have the ability to keybind mouse buttons (LMB, RMB, middle and mouse buttons 4-7) and to change the key bindings for interactions such as:
[list][*] Ask client to leave the pub,
[*] Hide Beer Tray
[*] Main objects interaction[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] Due to the changes in the keybindings system, custom key mappings will reset to default in the newest game version.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list][*]Added saves for story mode and sandbox separately.
[*]Added manual saves.
[*]Changed keybindings now show up correctly in the tutorial.
[*] Ability to change keybindings for interactions.
[*]Trash will no longer get stuck under the food truck.
[*]Glasses will no longer get stuck under the tap.
[*]Other minor fixes.[/list]
[b]And, once again, if any of the fixed issues continue to occur, please try starting a new game. If the errors persist, please report them to us so we can fix them![/b]
[list][*]Report the bug through this form: https://mov.gs/support/
[*]Include your PC specification: CPU, GPU, RAM
[*]If you encountered a crash, include a crash log from this folder: C:\Users\Username\AppData\LocalLow\Star Drifters\Brewpub Simulator - simply zip up the whole Brewpub Simulator folder and attach the compressed file to your message[/list]
Have fun gaming!

[b]If any of the fixed issues continue to occur, please try starting a new game. If the errors persist, please report them to us so we can fix them![/b]

notes.title: Fixes, Solutions + Guides for Common Issues
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Our team is working on fixes based on your feedback, but there are ways to overcome some issues that you frequently report. Here’s a quick FAQ that might help you right away, and also ensure you get a response from us ASAP.

[b]If you want to report a problem not addressed below, you can do it in our forum thread.[/b]

Table of contents:
A. Tips for all players 
B. Difficult recipe guides

[h1]A. Tips for all players[/h1]

[b]1. My game is not launching / crashing[/b]

E-mail us (support@moviegames.pl) with your full PC specifications and crash logs from the following folder after you have tried to launch the game and it crashed: C:\Users\Username\AppData\LocalLow\Star Drifters\Brewpub Simulator - simply zip up the whole Brewpub Simulator folder.

Additionally, here is a list of things that you could try right now in order to fix this issue:
- [u]Clear Download Cache in Steam[/u] - open Steam and go to Steam settings, open Downloads tab and use the option "Clear Download Cache". After that restart Steam and see if it helped,
- [u]Repair Library Folder[/u] - open Steam and go to Steam settings, open Storage tab, choose the folder that you install your games on, find an icon with 3 dots (settings icon), click on it and then choose option "Repair Folder". After that restart Steam and see if it helped,
- [u]Verify integrity of game files on Steam[/u] - select the game you are having problems with from your Steam library, open its Properties panel, open Installed files tab and select option "Verify integrity of game files". After that restart Steam and see if it helped,
- [u]Delete game folder from AppData[/u] - go to the following location on your PC: C:\Users\Username\AppData\LocalLow\Star Drifters\Brewpub Simulator and delete the entire Brewpub Simulator folder. After that restart Steam and see if it helped,
- [u]Reinstall the game and run Steam as an administrator[/u] - if you find that all of the suggestions listed above won't help, you could also reinstall the game and run Steam as an administrator to see if that helps,
- [u]Update all drivers on your PC[/u] - having the latest software installed on your PC might help you with launching the game,
- [u]Lower graphic options in the game,[/u]
- [u]Close 3rd party programs that may noticeably affect your PC while playing the game[/u] - this includes software like OBS, MSI Afterburner or other software made for recording or altering PC performance.

[b]2. I can't click or interact with anything[/b]

Load a save where the problem did not occur and try to continue playing. Alternatively, check the integrity of the game files and clear the AppData (C:\Users\Username\AppData\LocalLow\Star Drifters\Brewpub Simulator), but be aware that clearing the AppData will reset your progress.

[b]3. Items disappear/fall through the map[/b]

Open your inventory (“I” on the keyboard) → use Enter on the keyboard to trigger the function "Hide all" → confirm the warning pop up → unretrievable items should be now available from within your inventory.

Using this option will also hide the rest of the items placed in the pub to your inventory which might be inconvenient, but you should recover lost items that way. To avoid this bug in the future, try placing items on the map at a slower pace, this should help you prevent this issue from occuring again.

[b]4. Longer sessions may decrease game performance[/b]

Turn the game off and on again, longer sessions can cause the cache to get clogged, so you need to clear it and performance should return to normal. If not, send us (support@moviegames.pl) the PC specs and AppData (C:\Users\Username\AppData\LocalLow\Star Drifters\Brewpub Simulator), the problem should be fixed in the patch.

[b]5. The tablet interface does not work properly when opened, the player can move the character in the background, and there is no cursor and the tablet cannot be used.[/b]

Exit to the menu and reload the latest game save.

[b]6. “Continue” button stops working in the nightly summary UI[/b]

Press ESC to exit the interface.

[b]7. The game itself switches from window mode to full screen when exiting to the main menu[/b]

Change it back manually in the game settings.

[b]8. In the recipe for American Black Ale, the amount of magnum hops in the ingredient list (7G) does not agree with the amount in the preparation steps (8G).[/b]

8G of magnum hops is the correct amount. We will fix this in the patch.

[b]9. Brewing American Black Ale according to the recipe can wrongly result in American Porter.[/b]

This issue should not be occurring each time you brew Black Ale, but there is a chance of encountering it. We will fix this in the patch.

[b]10.After expanding the pub area, there will be a piece of paper on the floor that cannot be picked up.[/b]

Remove it by clicking on the gray dot next to it.

[b]11. Mini-games will become inactive if the player asks the customer out while the customer is using them.[/b]

The problem fixes itself after loading the game or purchasing a new mini-game. Darts and Arcade Machine also fix themselves after finishing and starting another night.

[b]12. I can’t see the remaining trash to pick up or places to clean.[/b]

Click Shift on the keyboard to see all the mess - even in the air.

[h1]B. Difficult Recipe Guides[/h1]
[b]Sweet Beer:[/b]
[spoiler]Brew American Pale Ale from the recipe, and after you have transferred the mixture to the fermentation bucket, add 10g of strawberry to the bucket and start fermenting the beer.[/spoiler]

[b]Fancy Beer:[/b]
[spoiler] Brew American Pale Ale from the recipe, and after you have transferred the mixture to the fermentation bucket, add 10g of cocoa powder, coffee and vanilla (or something else, experiments are welcome) to the bucket and start fermenting the beer [/spoiler]

[b]I created my own beer![/b]
Great! That’s what it’s all about. Share it on our [url=https://discord.gg/xtPbZ6tN9b]Discord[/url], in the dedicated thread!

We hope these guidelines will let you fully enjoy Brewpub Simulator before our fixes are in. If you have any other issue to report, do it in our forum thread, or contact support@moviegames.pl.

Cheers!

notes.title: Beer Diaries: Do you have a shovel? Let’s play in our sandbox!
notes.content:
[h2]Part 6 of Beer Diaries, y’all! Did you bring your shovel and bucket? We’re gonna dig into the sandbox![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/10623895dd5b947154b738d9ffeee496926c8057.gif[/img]

So yes, we have a sandbox mode. 📜 After you’ve played the story mode already you might want to just freely run your brewpub without any directions you get in the story mode. Or maybe any narrative 🗣️ is not your glass of beer and you wanna skip it completely. Valid but also SHAME because it’s fun to know the history of the place you own! 

[h2]Anyway. In the sandbox mode you don’t start like this:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/30865420ab16f83756cda63f126e0bb00eda7552.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/14cf783cd2acb5efbc0d903538402ee92d92ecec.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/da0e7aef61aba2a23bd2dfddcf6c1e7dd45371bb.jpg[/img]
[h2]You start with this:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/a54615611d64801c17b7c6be257746990ba26d1c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/0f2bbb580624c97221b0e77ca3292eff5293e9a1.jpg[/img]
You also have a bit more money 💰 to play with, more decorations are unlocked 🎍, and you have more beer recipes available 📝, too. All that is to allow you the full brewpub running experience without the hassle of unlocking the stuff first.

[h2]So what can you do in the sandbox? 🤔[/h2]

Well, basically everything! Decorate your pub however you want it to look 🖼️ (within the confines of the money you have, obviously), brew beers with or without the recipes 🍺, clean up, open your bar 🧹 and serve your customers to earn money 💸.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/24ea1ef7421dbcd0c1ba62735c3964d6ff468a45.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/b579dd174b686e22d4d6a7f80c362b6cb176f79a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/878028e7a99eae02ca8f2087e2ed058f37d31bd6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/79187b1c33585297ddcd74a893126aaf2b17603e.png[/img]
With that money 💵, you can buy new furniture and decorations 🛋️, and more ingredients for your brewing experiments. You can make the bar look however you want! There are also minigames to play and brewing competitions to win 🏆.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/c0766320dde892c2fcd8783adc746698f77068b6.jpg[/img]

So, what are you going to start with?

notes.title: Don’t be blue, it’s the day o’ the green!
notes.content:
[h2]It’s St. Patrick’s Day![/h2]
It is an important day for the lovers of all beer and Irish.

[previewyoutube=XE3x5S2W_3g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Demo change log[/h2]
If you want to see what we’ve also been brewing for you, check out new changes:
[list]
[*] several dozens new decorations (to be hung on walls and placed on surfaces)
[*] dirtiness system
[*] parcel machine
[*] 15 new glasses
[*] 2 beer dyes (green and blue)
[*] 33 new character models
[*] prestige of the pub, which determines which customers come in
[*] possibility to change the appearance of the front wall of the pub and the bar countertop
[*] ability to edit the bar logo
[*] sanitary control
[/list]
[h2]St. Patrick’s themed wallpapers[/h2]
For that occasion we’ve also prepared some wallpapers for your desktop and your phone. You can grab them from [b][url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Cqu9vLfC2FWXCWnb2C6Mw-EsAxwA_y05?usp=share_link]here[/url][/b].

[h2]Who's St.Patrick anyway?[/h2]

Everyone knows what it means: green hats, shamrocks everywhere, and, of course, Guinness. But why exactly do we drink beer on St. Patrick’s Day? And why is this holiday so green forward? (Also, some more info about the demo at the end, don’t miss it!)

Let’s start at the beginning. St. Patrick is probably the most recognizable patron of Ireland, even tho he wasn’t Irish himself. Patrick was born in Great Britain, then captured and enslaved as a young boy. As a slave, he was brought to Ireland for the first time but luckily he managed to escape.

Back in England, he became a cleric. As a servant to God, he had a vision telling him to bring Christianity to Ireland which was largely polytheistic up until that point. And so, he did. And now the Irish celebrate on the anniversary of his death.

There are a lot of legends surrounding St. Patrick, some more ludicrous than others but all generally entertaining. Driving all snakes from the island? How cool is that?

But then why do we drink beer on St. Patrick’s? The answer is simple: on this day Christians are allowed to put aside their Lenten restrictions on food and alcohol consumption. So you can imagine that turned into a rather huge celebration involving the most popular (and most readily available) alcoholic drink of the time. Cheers!

[b]Speaking of beer, we have a pretty green surprise waiting for you in our demo right now![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/598aac0817201931c6170af4e58d34786abaedac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/193f26ab238cf2bd1733f03f51c8d0402520001a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/1e64be4ce956b8e2002728bf386d3afa66a1c083.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/d4409070564616db4b25795c6951d27adfe7d72e.jpg[/img]

Fun fact: St. Patrick’s Day = green. Why? Because shamrock, the three-leaf clover, is green! Supposedly Patrick explained the concept of the Holy Trinity using shamrock leaves. Clever! Since then shamrock has been incorporated as one of the symbols for this holiday… and turned EVERYTHING green!

It turned beers green too. 

Besides the green beer, you can also expect some more Patrick-themed decorations to boost your celebratory mood when you’re playing Brewpub Simulator demo. Be sure to show us the results!

Happy St. Patrick’s Day, Brewers!

notes.title: So how do YOU rate the demo?
notes.content:
The demo has been out for a while now, so it’s time to see what YOU think about it!

Let’s take a look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42754502/007973e2683a77053d7d163a002c8e9a69a72772.png[/img]

You know what? You’re all incredible! No improvements would have been possible without your feedback. You’re so honest with your opinions (sometimes brutally so) but we love it nonetheless. Keep them coming!

Btw, remember that you can still play the demo. And what are we working on now?
[list]
[*] customer interactions (more on that soon), 
[*] more decoration and customizing options,
[*] brewing competitions,
[*] new beer recipes,
[*] new equipment to make your life at a pub easier!
[/list]
and more of course [i]*wink wink*[/i]

What do we mean by more decorations and customization? Well, obviously, more wallpapers, floor styles, furniture, the usual. But we also wanted to allow the players to make the pub truly theirs. We would have loved that option for ourselves too, so we made it possible to change the front of the pub and customize its logo. This way you’ll have a chance to make this space uniquely yours!

Brewpub Simulator is not just about sitting in your workshop, making beers and then selling them to people in the pub. It should be possible for you to prove your brewing mastery, right? So we put competition in the game! As a brewpub owner, you can get an invitation to a contest for which you’ll have to brew a fresh keg of your best beer and send it to them to be judged. Fame and fortune await! We think ;D But it also means we need to enlarge the repertoire of brews, so we are introducing more recipes into the game. They will include Stouts, Porters, Pilsners, and more.

And what about the new equipment? The idea hit us square in the face the more we played our own game. Trays. A normal thing you see in any pub, so why not introduce it here too? That started us thinking about the mechanics: is it a skill? How hard would it be to master? Do you unlock it at a certain point or do you have a tray in your inventory straight away? We’re not gonna tell you yet but it’s an interesting mechanic to figure out ;) And dishwashers. We need actual dishwashers in a pub. Of course. So we made it happen.

We’re happy to see you like the demo as it is, and we are now working on improvements, fixes, and polishes. All thanks to you. So, thanks and… see you behind the counter!
